title: Ajira Digital Design Replica
description: Recreated an Ajira Digital visual as a design practice project to improve layout accuracy, typography, composition and visual consistency.
objective: Improve the ability to analyse and accurately recreate an existing visual composition while developing stronger design fundamentals.
steps: Analysed the reference visual and its composition.
Recreated key layout and visual elements.
Reviewed the final composition for consistency and presentation quality.
results: Created a portfolio practice recreation demonstrating visual communication, layout, typography and attention to detail.
